obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Restore service within forty-eight hours to residential and small business customers terminated during the COVID-19 state of emergency.
obligations.quote: Utility corporations and municipalities shall have a duty to restore service, to the extent not already required under this chapter, to any residential or small business customer within forty-eight hours if such service has been terminated during the pendency of the COVID-19 state of emergency.
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from terminating service of residential and small business customers for arrears for 180 days after the emergency ends or December 31, 2021, whichever is earlier.
obligations.quote: For a period of one hundred eighty days after either the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires or December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-one, whichever is earlier, no utility corporation or municipality shall terminate or disconnect the service of a residential or small business customer because of defaulted deferred payment agreements or arrears
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Give residential and small business customers the right to enter into or restructure deferred payment agreements without a down payment, late fees or penalties.
obligations.quote: The utility corporation or municipality shall provide such residential or small business customer with the right to enter into, or restructure, a deferred payment agreement without the requirement of a down payment, late fees, or penalties, as such is provided for in this article
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Notify residential and small business customers of the section's provisions and make reasonable efforts to offer deferred payment agreements.
obligations.quote: Every utility corporation or municipality shall provide notice to residential and small business customers, in a writing to be included with a bill statement or, when appropriate, via electronic transmission the provisions of this section and shall further make reasonable efforts to contact customers who have demonstrated a change in financial circumstances
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from terminating service to, or placing, selling or enforcing a lien on the property of, residential and small business customers during the COVID-19 state of emergency.
obligations.quote: No municipality shall terminate or discontinue service to, or place, sell or enforce any lien on the real property of, a residential customer, a non-residential customer whose account serves residential premises, or a small business with twenty-five or fewer employees that is not a (a) publicly held company, or a subsidiary thereof,
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Restore service within forty-eight hours to residential, residential-premises and small business customers terminated during the emergency.
obligations.quote: Every municipality shall have a duty to restore service to any residential customer, non-residential customer whose account serves residential premises, or small business customer within forty-eight hours of the effective date of this subdivision if such service has been terminated during the pendency of the COVID-19 state of emergency.
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from terminating service or enforcing liens for arrears for 180 days after the emergency ends or December 31, 2021, whichever is earlier.
obligations.quote: no municipality shall terminate or discontinue the service of, or place, sell or enforce any lien on the real property of, a residential customer, a non-residential customer whose account serves residential premises or small business customer because of bill arrears, taxes, or fees owed to the municipality
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Give affected customers the right to enter into or restructure a deferred payment agreement without a down payment, late fees or penalties.
obligations.quote: The municipality shall provide a residential customer, a non-residential customer whose account serves residential premises, or small business service customer that has experienced a change in financial circumstances due to the COVID-19 state of emergency with the right to enter into, or restructure, a deferred payment agreement
obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from terminating service or enforcing liens for arrears after the emergency unless thirty days earlier it sent a notice of intention and notice of rights.

obligations.law_title: Relates to extending a moratorium on utility termination of services after the COVID-19 state of emergency is lifted or expires
